title: GanttDiagram
description: The gantt diagram body: a time-scheduled bar chart. It carries diagram-level date and axis settings, excluded dates, flat sections, and tasks whose start and end are expressed as dates, durations, or references to other tasks. A sibling of the flowchart and class diagram bodies in this folder; it reuses the same method (self-contained $defs, readable enums, OCP-open objects) over gantt's own shape.
$comment: Deferred, to revisit: Interaction — `click <taskId> call/href` — not yet modeled. (Mirrors the flowchart and class diagram deferrals.)

title.description: An optional title displayed at the top of the chart.

dateFormat.description: The format of the date input of the gantt elements (dayjs tokens, e.g. `YYYY-MM-DD`, the default, or `X` for a Unix timestamp). Defines how `startDate`/`endDate` strings are parsed.

axisFormat.description: The output date format on the rendered axis (d3-time-format tokens, e.g. `%Y-%m-%d`). Default `YYYY-MM-DD`.

tickInterval.description: The axis tick spacing, a positive integer followed by a unit, e.g. `1day` or `1week`. Default is auto.

excludes.description: Dates excluded from task duration calculations. Each entry is a specific date (in `dateFormat`), a day of the week (e.g. `sunday`), or `weekends`. The word `weekdays` is not supported.

todayMarker.description: The today marker. A style string (e.g. `stroke-width:5px,stroke:#0f0,opacity:0.5`), or `off` to hide it.

tasks.description: Tasks not placed in a section.

weekday.description: The weekday a week-based `tickInterval` starts on. Default is sunday.

weekendStart.description: Which day the weekend starts on when excluding weekends (v11.0.0+). `saturday` is the default (Saturday and Sunday); `friday` makes the weekend Friday and Saturday.

taskType.description: The kind of gantt element. `task` a normal bar; `milestone` a single instant drawn at startDate + duration/2 (Mermaid `milestone`); `verticalMarker` a full-height reference line that takes no row (Mermaid `vert`).

taskTag.description: A status tag on a task. `active` (Mermaid `active`); `done` (`done`); `critical` (`crit`).

duration.description: A task length: a number (decimals allowed) followed by a unit suffix. `ms` milliseconds; `s` seconds; `m` minutes; `h` hours; `d` days; `w` weeks; `M` months; `y` years. Example `30d` or `1.5d`.

task.description: A gantt task. Start and end are composed from the fields below, mirroring Mermaid's task metadata: start is `startDate`, else `after` (the latest end of the referenced tasks), else the preceding task's end when both are omitted; end is `endDate`, else `duration` (added to the start), else `until` (the start of the referenced tasks). Set at most one start source and at most one end source.

id.description: The task id, referenced by other tasks' `after` and `until`.

after.description: Start at the latest end of these task ids (Mermaid `after <id> ...`). Ignored if `startDate` is set.

until.description: End at the start of these task ids (Mermaid `until <id> ...`, v10.9.0+). Ignored if `endDate` or `duration` is set.
